blockingFindings.title: R4 diagnostic context assertion is too permissive
blockingFindings.target: specs/289-fix-plugin-agent-default/tests/agent-resolution.test.js R4 includes resolution context when no provider can be resolved
blockingFindings.issue: The assertion `assert.match(err.message, /explicit|SENTI_PROFILE|useProfile|profile selection/i)` can pass solely because the message mentions an explicit provider override, without proving that explicit/profile environment selection context is present. The same test also only checks the phrase `provider override`, not the actual absent override state.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert distinct diagnostic fields or concrete text for provider override state and profile/environment selection, such as provider override being absent/none and useProfile/SENTI_PROFILE selection details.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 explicitly requires commandId, provider override state, explicit/profile environment selection, active profile name, default key, and reason. The current test can pass while omitting one of those required diagnostic fields.
